subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my note about pointing retargeting at the one event that pays your P&L, the paid resubscribe. The point worth repeating: we read every conversion through a server-to-server postback off your billing stack and hold it through the first billing cycle, so a free reactivation never counts as a paid one, and active subscribers are suppressed so spend never chases people already paying. At scale that runs near 6,200 paid resubscribes a day off retargeting (illustrative). If it helps, I can pull the lapsed-cohort read by tier. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate paid-resubscribe validation + active-subscriber suppression proof
illustrative_flags: 6,200 paid resubscribes a day off retargeting (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN subscription_media: references prior outreach in S1; restates single proof (billing-side S2S paid-subscription postback + first-billing-cycle hold + active-subscriber suppression); one illustrative MobUpps figure (6,200/day, flagged); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y' (stated positively); native English, no transliteration; no brand named.
